# echo

Print argument text through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/echo hello world

moonx cli/echo -e 'one\ntwo'
```

Join arguments with spaces and append a newline by default. -n omits the newline; -e and -E control backslash escapes.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-n` | Omit the final newline. |
| `-e` | Enable backslash escapes. |
| `-E` | Disable backslash escapes. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- POSIXLY_CORRECT enables escapes; only an initial -n permits option parsing in that mode.
- -- is printed literally. --help and --version are metadata only when used alone; use printf for unambiguous option-like text.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
